rules.title: Nothing uses a field the model does not have
rules.why: A measure or visual that reads a removed or renamed field shows an error to every reader.

rules.title: Copies of a certified metric match its agreed DAX
rules.why: Measures named like a certified metric must say the same thing in every file, unless a reviewer accepted the difference.

rules.title: Every measure is in the Ready state
rules.why: A measure in the Error state breaks every visual that shows it.

rules.title: Every measure is used
rules.why: Unused measures make the field list harder to read and are easy to use by mistake. Check reports on the published model before removing one.

rules.title: Visible measures have a description
rules.why: The description is the tooltip report builders see in the field list.

rules.title: Visible measures have a format string
rules.why: Without one, every visual formats the number its own way.

rules.title: Divide with DIVIDE, not /
rules.why: / returns an error when dividing by zero; DIVIDE returns blank, and is as fast.

rules.title: Measure names are tidy
rules.why: Stray spaces make two measures look the same. Add a regular expression to enforce a naming pattern.

rules.title: Measures in busy tables sit in display folders
rules.why: Folders keep a long field list usable.

rules.title: Helper measures are hidden
rules.why: Measures named as helpers are building blocks, not for report builders.

rules.title: Hidden columns are used by something
rules.why: A hidden column nothing reads still takes memory and refresh time.

rules.title: Avoid IFERROR and ISERROR
rules.why: They force the engine to evaluate row by row; test for the case instead.

rules.title: No two measures have the same DAX
rules.why: Two copies drift apart: keep one and point the other at it, or remove it.

rules.title: Visible columns have a description
rules.why: Off by default: worth it for shared semantic models.

rules.title: Measure chains stay shallow
rules.why: Off by default: very deep chains are hard to follow and to change safely.

exceptions.reason: A helper for the calculation group: nothing in the report reads it directly.
